name: docrithm-pdf-gen
description: Synthetic, multi-layout purchase-order (PO) and purchase-invoice (PI) PDF generator for stress-testing the DocRithm document-processing app. Produces realistic Indian B2B procurement documents (GSTIN, HSN, CGST/SGST/IGST, INR) across multiple fictitious vendors, buyers and visual layouts, with deliberate edge-case scenarios baked in as ground truth.
author: Ravindra Singh <ravindra@rkinnovate.com>
